TASSEL / rTASSEL official example data
=======================================

Bundled small VCF:
  Repository: maize-genetics/rTASSEL
  Path: inst/extdata/rt_sub_chr1.vcf
  Source: https://github.com/maize-genetics/rTASSEL/blob/master/inst/extdata/rt_sub_chr1.vcf
  Git blob SHA: 7339a9298075490d921920b92771cda861d0c539

Full maize VCF used in the rTASSEL vignette:
  File: maize_chr9_10thin40000.recode.vcf
  Repository path: inst/extdata/maize_chr9_10thin40000.recode.vcf
  Source: https://github.com/maize-genetics/rTASSEL/blob/master/inst/extdata/maize_chr9_10thin40000.recode.vcf
  Raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maize-genetics/rTASSEL/master/inst/extdata/maize_chr9_10thin40000.recode.vcf
  Git blob SHA: 016ef9420312e2305e20c69fad225de0411ae056

Other official rTASSEL extdata files available from the same directory include
mdp_genotype.hmp.txt, mdp_phenotype.txt, mdp_population_structure.txt, and
wheat_gbs_test.vcf.

The small VCF is bundled here only to provide an immediately inspectable official
TASSEL-format VCF. Use download_tassel_official_data.R to retrieve the full
public examples directly from the upstream repository.
